name: Douro River Boat Party
description: Take the party to the water with a scenic boat trip along the Douro, complete with music, dancing, and unparalleled views of the city skyline.
longDescription:
The Douro River Boat Party on May 9, 2026, offers a nightlife event on the waters of the Douro. This event is designed as a floating celebration, providing an alternative setting for evening entertainment in Porto. It combines a river cruise with a party atmosphere, distinct from typical land-based venues.

Attendees can expect an evening characterized by music and dancing, set against the backdrop of the city's illuminated riverfront. The event takes place on a boat navigating the Douro, offering views of Porto from the water. The duration of the boat party is typically several hours, catering to an adult audience seeking a social evening out.

Ticketing information for the Douro River Boat Party will be available closer to the date. Details regarding the exact departure point on the Douro River will be specified upon ticket release, but locations along the Ribeira are common. Accessibility information for the specific vessel will also be provided by the organizers.
